article_title: Nifty: Five reasons India's markets are sinking even when its economy is growing

tasks.prompt: What puzzle does the article set out to explain?
options: Why India's economy has stopped growing completely
Why Korean investors are buying only Indian government bonds
Why Indian stock markets are weak even though the economy is growing above 7%
Why India no longer imports crude oil
tasks.correct_answer: Why Indian stock markets are weak even though the economy is growing above 7%
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מסבירה את הפער בין צמיחת הכלכלה ההודית ביותר מ־7% לבין הביצועים החלשים של שוק המניות.

tasks.prompt: How much did foreign institutional investors withdraw from Indian markets in the past two years, according to Bernstein Research?
options: $40bn
$5bn
tasks.explanation_hebrew: לפי נתוני Bernstein Research, משקיעים מוסדיים זרים משכו 40 מיליארד דולר בשנתיים האחרונות.

tasks.prompt: What does “erode” mean when the article says investors saw their wealth erode by about 15%?
options: Increase suddenly
Remain unchanged
Move into mutual funds
Gradually decrease in value
tasks.explanation_hebrew: בהקשר זה erode פירושו להישחק או לרדת בהדרגה בערך; המשקיעים איבדו בערך 15% מהונם.

tasks.prompt: Why do high US bond yields draw money away from Indian equities?
options: US bonds guarantee profits of 170%
They are seen as safer investments while offering yields above 5%
Indian law prevents foreigners from owning shares
Oil companies are required to buy them
tasks.correct_answer: They are seen as safer investments while offering yields above 5%
tasks.explanation_hebrew: אג״ח ממשלת ארה״ב נחשבות השקעה כמעט נטולת סיכון ומציעות תשואה מעל 5%, ולכן הן מושכות כסף מנכסים מסוכנים יותר בשווקים מתעוררים.

tasks.prompt: Why is the fall in Indian shares especially worrying for households?
options: Households are forbidden from selling mutual funds
All domestic banks have closed their savings accounts
Many more households now hold stocks and mutual funds while also facing weak jobs, inflation and consumption
Only foreign investors are exposed to the losses
tasks.correct_answer: Many more households now hold stocks and mutual funds while also facing weak jobs, inflation and consumption
tasks.explanation_hebrew: מספר ההודים שמשקיעים במניות ובקרנות עלה מאוד, ולכן הירידות פוגעות בחיסכון של משקי בית שכבר מתמודדים עם שוק עבודה חלש ואינפלציה.

tasks.prompt: What does “resilience” refer to in the final paragraph?
options: Indian savers continuing their monthly mutual-fund investments despite the correction
Foreign investors withdrawing all their funds
Oil prices remaining above $100 forever
Indian large companies avoiding all competition
tasks.correct_answer: Indian savers continuing their monthly mutual-fund investments despite the correction
tasks.explanation_hebrew: החוסן הוא המשך ההפקדות החודשיות של החוסכים ההודים לקרנות נאמנות למרות הירידות והחרדה הגוברת.

tasks.prompt: List the five reasons the article gives for the weakness of India's stock market.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין את כל חמשת הגורמים בכותרות הכתבה: זעזועי אנרגיה מתמשכים, ריבית עולמית עולה, רופי נחלש, תמחור מניות עדיין גבוה יחסית והחולשה בתחום ה־AI או הכלכלה החדשה.
expected_points: Persistent energy shocks linked to Middle East conflict.
Indian shares remain relatively expensive compared with earnings and rival emerging markets.
India lacks large globally competitive AI or new-economy companies.

tasks.prompt: Summarise how oil prices affect India's markets through several connected channels.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר את שרשרת ההשפעה: הודו מייבאת מעל 90% מהנפט, השיבוש במצר הורמוז מעלה מחירים, ומחיר גבוה מגביר אינפלציה, ריבית ולחץ על רווחי החברות ושולי הרווח.
expected_points: India imports more than 90% of its crude needs, with much of its energy passing through the Strait of Hormuz.
Shipping disruption has kept crude near $90–$100 a barrel.
Prices above $100 would pressure inflation, company earnings and profit margins.
Higher inflation contributes to rising interest rates and weaker demand for riskier equities.

tasks.prompt: Why does India's missing AI sector matter to foreign investors, according to the article?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לקשר בין רווחי ה־AI הגבוהים בעולם, אופיין הישן יחסית של חברות הענק ההודיות, הקנה המידה הקטן של החדשנות המקומית והצורך בתעשיות תחרותיות גלובלית.
expected_points: A large share of current global profit growth is concentrated in AI and the new economy.
Many Indian large-cap companies represent older industries and are not investing enough in the future.
Promising Indian areas such as semiconductors, space and deep tech remain too small to influence major allocation decisions.
Foreign capital is more likely to return if India builds globally competitive firms in these sectors.

tasks.prompt: Write a brief investor note explaining one factor that could help Indian markets recover and one risk that could prevent recovery.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: הפתק צריך לבחור גורם חיובי מן הכתבה, כגון ירידת מתיחות גיאופוליטית או תמחור אטרקטיבי יותר, ולצדו סיכון כמו מחירי אנרגיה גבוהים, מתיחות סחר או תיקון עמוק יותר.
expected_points: Identify one article-supported positive factor: easing geopolitical tensions, more attractive valuations, continued domestic flows, or competitive emerging industries.
Identify one article-supported risk: high energy prices, trade tensions, high rates, weak currency, or a deeper correction.
Explain briefly how each factor could affect investor flows or company performance.
